title: Stalwart
scope: Version reported by the running server at its last recorded start.

title: Mailbox storage
scope: Stored size and quota per user account. Mail contents are not read; manage accounts in the Stalwart WebUI.
findings: archive@example.org, sales@example.org and newsletter@example.net use 90 % or more of their quota.
Only the first 12 accounts are listed.

title: Native metrics exporter
scope: Community metrics exported by the running server; a counter it has not exported since it started counts as zero.

title: Mail server
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Reverse proxy
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: DNS resolver
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Virus scanner
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Scanner milter
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Garrison macro filter
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Garrison web service
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Garrison event receiver
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Garrison maintenance broker
scope: A running process does not prove that it handled mail correctly.

title: Garrison collector schedule
scope: The loaded schedule; a successful run is shown by the job's receipt.

title: Garrison collector watch
scope: The loaded schedule; a successful run is shown by the job's receipt.

title: Certificate renewal
scope: The loaded schedule; a successful run is shown by the job's receipt.

title: Backup job
scope: What systemd reports of the job's last run; it does not prove what the job did.

title: System updates
scope: What systemd reports of the job's last run; it does not prove what the job did.

title: ClamAV
scope: Installed binary; the running process version is not verified.

title: Garrison release
scope: The newest release GitHub lists, asked once a day.

title: Stalwart release
scope: The newest release GitHub lists, asked once a day.

title: Health endpoint
scope: The endpoint answered; this does not test user functionality.

title: System updates
scope: What the package manager would install, from the metadata the host has fetched; asked every six hours.

title: Restart of the host
scope: The distribution's own marker where it writes one, and the installed kernels against the running one.

title: Clock synchronisation
scope: Whether the system clock follows a time server. Mail authentication and TLS depend on the time.

title: Disk forecast
scope: The free space of the last two weeks, read hourly, carried forward in a straight line.

title: Firewall service
scope: Whether a firewall service of the host runs; its rules are not read.

title: Antivirus configuration
scope: On-disk configuration; whether the running daemons loaded it is not verified.

title: Signature databases
scope: File times do not prove a successful update check or a loaded database.

title: Milter verdicts
scope: What the scanner behind the milter said of the mail it was shown on each of the last seven days (UTC).

title: Test messages
scope: Garrison handed the test messages to the local SMTP listener without signing in, addressed to garrison-test@example.org; the next test follows 24 hours after this one.

rows: refused: 554 5.7.1 Message rejected by a milter
refused: 550 5.7.1 Message refused: an attached Office document contains macros.

title: Native spam filter and classifier
scope: Configured values. A rule count or queued sample does not prove learning.

title: Spam and ham
scope: How Stalwart's filter filed delivered mail on each of the last seven days (UTC).

title: Spam and ham by domain
scope: The same seven days by the domain of the mailbox the mail went to.

title: Checks of incoming senders
scope: How the mail of the last seven days fared in Stalwart's checks of its sender. Not passed includes senders that publish no record to check against.

title: Sender domains that fail the checks
scope: Domains whose mail failed SPF or DMARC in the last seven days: forged senders, or a sender whose own records are wrong. A domain without a record is not listed.

title: Webmail plugins
scope: Administrator configuration; execution in browsers is not tested here.

title: Sending accounts
scope: Mail that signed-in accounts handed in during the last 24 hours, against each account's own average of the 14 days before. Read every ten minutes; nothing is blocked.
findings: jonas.weber@example.org: 2,984 recipients in 24 hours, where 38 a day are usual; 1,422 of them bounced; handed in from 14 addresses.
newsletter@example.net: 48,210 recipients in 24 hours, where 6,120 a day are usual.

title: restic repository
scope: What the backup tool said of its repository when `garrison backup-check` last asked it. A test restore proves that the newest snapshot can be read with the password; it does not compare the restored files with the originals.

title: Local full backup
scope: What the backup job wrote when it last finished; it does not prove that the copy can be restored.

title: Restore test
scope: Historical result reported by the job; not a current test.

title: DNS records of example.org
scope: What Stalwart names for the domain, asked of this host's resolver now. Records marked optional are a matter of choice; another resolver may still hold older answers.

title: DNS records of example.net
scope: What Stalwart names for the domain, asked of this host's resolver now. Records marked optional are a matter of choice; another resolver may still hold older answers.

title: DNS records of example.com
scope: What Stalwart names for the domain, asked of this host's resolver now. Records marked optional are a matter of choice; another resolver may still hold older answers.

title: Blocklists
scope: Whether an address this server sends from stands on a blocklist that receiving servers ask. The lists learn the addresses asked about. Asked every six hours.

title: Reverse names
scope: Each address this server sends from should have a reverse name that leads back to it and is the name the server greets with.

title: TLS certificates
source: Local TLS handshake with SNI and chain validation
scope: Proves what the local listener presents; public reachability and automatic renewal are not tested here.

title: TLS in transit
scope: Mail of the last seven days between this server and others: incoming on port 25 with and without STARTTLS, and outgoing deliveries to hosts that offered TLS or did not.

title: Notifications
source: ntfy at notify.example.org, webhook at hooks.example.org, mail to ops@example.org
scope: Garrison sends a message on these channels when one of its checks fails or warns in two runs in a row, and when it is in order again.

fields.label: Channels
fields.value: ntfy at notify.example.org, webhook at hooks.example.org, mail to ops@example.org
